name: Project image
description: Works one of the project's own images into the shot - behind the effect, keyed in by the scene's own luminance, or over it with the storyboard's blend mode. Cover-fitted, continuously warped by the cue's treatment, pushed around by the scene's own edges, and pulled towards the run's palette.

treatment.description: Set by the cue's named treatment, not by hand: the index into IMAGE_TREATMENTS in engine/renderer.js.

warp.description: How hard the treatment is being applied. Never leave this at zero - a still photograph goes stale in about two seconds.

speed.description: Time multiplier for the treatment. Hotter sections should run faster.

displace.description: How much the scene's own luminance gradient pushes the picture about - the difference between two layers stacked and two layers mixed.

zoom.description: Scale on top of the cover fit. 1 exactly fills the frame.

drift.description: How far the framing wanders, in frame widths.

tone.description: How far the picture is pulled into the run's palette.

key.description: Behind only: how hard the scene punches through the image.

behind.description: Set by the cue's placement, not by hand: 1 puts the image under the scene.
